item.title: Blue top bins full of household rubbish never emptied by the bin men for the past 8 weeks and a big bin on the floor., 4th October
item.description:
Blue top bin not emptied and overflowing for the past 8 weeks. I reported this several times but it appears l am being ignored. I appreciate that whoever owns the bin must have put the wrong stuff in the blue top bin but l expect the general waste bin team to empty this bin. It has been there for ages. Please do something about this and let us leave in a clean environment. I am tired of reporting this issue repeatedly. Educate residents about putting the right stuff in the right bin. If bin men are refusing to empty the bin, let the council look for an alternative. Thank you.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Disraeli Close, Thamesmead

item.title: Lovely tree but the branches grew very long and need pruning, 4th October
item.description:
The three in front of no 3 grew very long branches over the front garden. Over the last year we had couple of instances when large branches broke off. One of them was reported as emergency and took down the cables of next door neighbour. On another occasion large branch landed on a car. I would appreciate if you could trim the tree to make it a bit safer please. Last time the team came over about 4 years ago but were unable to trim much as the cars were parked under the tree branches (driveway). Is there a possibility of arranging a time so we are able to move the cars please?
